sv.title: Sverige vägrade vara med på budgetmötet i Bryssel
sv.summary: Budgetmötet i Bryssel avslutades utan några beslut och ett nytt möte planeras i mitten av december. en.title: Sweden refused to take part in the budget meeting in Brussels
en.summary: The budget meeting in Brussels ended without any decisions and a new meeting is planned for mid-December. At the meeting, participants had hoped to agree on the next long-term budget and support for Ukraine, but the disagreement reportedly was so great that several countries, among them Sweden, protested by not attending the…
